segments.en: May we return to you, chapter “One who was married.”

segments.he: אַלְמָנָה נִיזּוֹנֶת מִנִּכְסֵי יְתוֹמִים — מַעֲשֵׂה יָדֶיהָ שֶׁלָּהֶן, וְאֵין חַיָּיבִין בִּקְבוּרָתָהּ. יוֹרְשֶׁיהָ יוֹרְשֵׁי כְתוּבָּתָהּ חַיָּיבִין בִּקְבוּרָתָהּ.
segments.en: «MISHNA:» «A widow is sustained from the property of orphans. Her earnings belong to them, and they are not obligated» to see «to her burial. Her heirs,» who «inherit her marriage contract, are obligated» to see «to her burial.»

moves.summary: rules on a widow's earnings and burial

positions.claim: the orphans take her earnings and are not obligated to bury her; the heirs of her ketuba must bury her
positions.basis: burial obligation follows inheritance of the ketuba
